items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: this fellow, Sergeant Price from Howard University, came on, and he broke the band up, really -- because he took Frank Wess, he took Oswald Gibson, he took my brother

ctx.x: And that little band went on for I guess two or three years, with different changes in it. The last one we had, Osie Johnson was the drummer in it. Because somewhere in there came the War, and Frank Wess went in the Army... As a matter of fact, this fellow, Sergeant Price from Howard University, came on, and he broke the band up, really -- because he took Frank Wess, he took Oswald Gibson, he took my brother, and I think Bubbus went with him. Anyway, the band was shattered. And what few guys were left, we billed…

But all the while this was going on, I was playing jobs at night with older musicians. For a long time when I worked around Washington, I was the youngest musician in the band. After the stint that I had with Jelly Roll Morton up there at the Jungle Inn, I think I made... I got a little band of my own, I believe, for a short while, and then came this thing where the WPA, which was...
